title: Wilton Crawley's stage act
summary: Barbarin describes Crawley's comic act, singing, jokes and contortionist clarinet playing.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

Victor. 38094.
It's not enlisted in there.
Oh, it's not enlisted, huh? You gonna find that record, you see?
Mm-hmm, do my best. There it is. There it is.

That alto here. Makes me cry. What a gal. She's driving me wild. Can't you kiss, hug, or squeeze? Does she know how to please? What a gal. She's driving me wild. Cute and neat, and so sweet. Yeah, playing the clarinet, sure. He'd do that. It was really something. It was something, yeah. He had a good act. That's why I say he was working all the time. He kept working all the time. Very good.
